entry.title: Caiden Gloves
entry.summary:
Vendor: Cues Master Shop
Type:
Price: 2200.00

The Caiden Gloves are high-performance billiard gloves designed to provide smooth cue movement, comfortable hand positioning, and consistent bridge-hand control. Built with performance fabrics and ergonomic construction, Caiden offers multiple glove designs to match the individual preferences and playing styles of today's players.

The gloves feature Ultra Slick Fabric for a smooth, low-friction surface, while Hyper Cool technology helps maintain comfort during extended sessions. Each model offers a different balance of coverage, ventilation, and direct hand contact, allowing players to choose the feel that best complements their stroke.

Features

  • Ultra Slick Fabric for smooth cue movement
  • Hyper Cool technology for enhanced cooling and comfort
  • Ergonomic, close-fitting construction
  • Lightweight and flexible design
  • Designed to reduce friction between the bridge hand and cue shaft
  • Anti-slip palm features for added stability
  • Available in different finger configurations
  • Designed for consistent bridge-hand movement and stroke control

Available Models

Classic — Full-finger design with an anti-slip silicone logo on the palm. Ideal for players who prefer maximum coverage and a smooth, traditional glove feel.

Comfort — Hybrid open-finger design with the thumb and index finger covered while the middle finger remains open. Features thinner fabric, ProCool Mesh, and a non-slip suede palm pad for improved ventilation and enhanced feel.

Contact — Open-finger design with all fingers exposed, providing maximum finger freedom and a more direct connection with the cue.

Performance

  • Ultra Slick Feel — Promotes smooth and effortless cue movement
  • Hyper Cool Comfort — Helps maintain comfort during extended playing sessions
  • Ergonomic Fit — Follows the natural movement of the hand
  • Flexible Options — Multiple designs allow players to choose their preferred level of coverage and hand contact
  • Stable Bridge — Anti-slip palm features provide additional stability during the stroke

Perfect For

Players looking for a performance-oriented billiard glove that combines smooth cue movement, cooling comfort, flexibility, and reliable bridge-hand control, with Classic, Comfort, and Contact designs to suit different playing preferences.

Smooth movement. Cool comfort. Total control. Caiden Gloves are built to keep your stroke effortless. 🎱

entry.title: HOW Gloves
entry.summary:
Vendor: Cues Master Shop
Type:
Price: 1700.00

The HOW Gloves are designed for players who demand a smooth, consistent stroke with unrestricted hand movement. Built with a lightweight and flexible construction, these billiard gloves create a low-friction surface between the bridge hand and cue shaft, allowing the cue to glide smoothly through the fingers for greater stroke consistency and control.

The back of the glove features high-stretch Lycra, providing flexibility and breathability for comfortable play during extended sessions. A reinforced anti-slip palm adds stability and durability, helping maintain a secure bridge position while allowing natural movement throughout the stroke.

Features

  • High-stretch Lycra back for flexibility and breathability
  • Reinforced anti-slip palm for added stability
  • Lightweight construction for comfortable extended play
  • Close, comfortable fit without restricting hand movement
  • Smooth surface designed to reduce friction against the cue shaft
  • Helps promote a smoother and more consistent stroke
  • Available for left and right hands
  • Available in XS, S/M, L/XL, and 2XL
  • Available in multiple colors

Available Colors

Army Green, Black, Deep Pink, Dream Purple, Grey, Lemon Yellow, Mint Blue, Navy Blue, Peacock Blue, Rose Pink, Sakura Pink, and Wine Red

Perfect For

Players looking for a lightweight, breathable, and flexible billiard glove that provides smooth cue movement, a stable bridge, and consistent performance from practice sessions to competitive play.

Smooth movement. Secure control. Consistent strokes. HOW Gloves are made to keep your game flowing. 🎱

entry.title: Predator Second Skin Glove
entry.summary:
Vendor: Cues Master Shop
Type:
Price: 2600.00

The Predator Second Skin Glove is a high-performance billiard glove engineered for players who demand an exceptionally smooth cue glide and a close, natural fit. Its Second-Skin low-friction surface minimizes drag between the bridge hand and cue shaft, helping players achieve a smoother, more consistent stroke with greater control.

Constructed with Ultra-Dry breathable mesh and Lycra, the glove combines flexibility, ventilation, and comfort for extended playing sessions. The non-slip thumb heel pad provides additional stability around the bridge hand, while double-stitched construction and an Elastic-Velcro closure help deliver durability and a secure, comfortable fit.

Features

  • Second-Skin low-friction surface for smooth cue movement
  • Ultra-Dry breathable mesh and Lycra construction
  • Close-fitting, flexible second-skin feel
  • Non-slip thumb heel pad for added stability
  • Double-stitched construction for improved durability
  • Elastic-Velcro closure for a secure and comfortable fit
  • Designed to reduce friction between the bridge hand and cue shaft
  • Available in different finger configurations
  • Available for left and right hands
  • Available in XXS, S/M, L/XL, and XXL

Available Configurations

Fingerless / Open-Fingertip — Provides greater fingertip freedom and direct hand contact while maintaining the smooth Second Skin feel.

Closed-Thumb — Offers additional thumb coverage while preserving flexibility and low-friction cue movement.

Closed-Finger — Provides full finger coverage for players who prefer maximum glove coverage and protection.

Performance

  • Second-Skin Glide — Low-friction surface allows the cue shaft to move smoothly through the bridge hand.
  • Ultra-Dry Comfort — Breathable mesh helps keep the hand comfortable during extended play.
  • Stable Bridge — Non-slip thumb heel pad provides additional control and stability.
  • Flexible Fit — Lycra construction allows natural hand movement without feeling restrictive.
  • Secure Fit — Elastic-Velcro closure helps keep the glove comfortably positioned during play.
  • Built to Last — Double-stitched construction reinforces areas exposed to repeated movement.

Perfect For

Players looking for a high-performance billiard glove that delivers smooth cue movement, low friction, breathability, flexibility, and consistent bridge-hand control from everyday practice to competitive play.

Second-skin comfort. Ultra-smooth glide. Total control. Predator Second Skin is built for a stroke without limits. 🎱
